name: Construction Site Pack 1:50 - 14 painted multi-colour models
description:
14 construction site models at 1:50, the scale of diecast construction equipment, for dioramas, model railways and desk display.

Every model comes as a painted 3MF for multi-colour printers (Bambu AMS, Snapmaker U1, Prusa MMU), with up to four filaments per model, and as a plain STL for single-colour printing. Thin parts such as handrails, ladders and forks are thickened so they print on a 0.4 mm nozzle, and the fence mesh is drawn as single 0.5 mm lines.

Included:
- Telehandler (10,000 lb class), 175 x 52 x 52 mm
- Trailer concrete line pump, 122 x 48 x 52 mm
- Towable air compressor, 101 x 37 x 46 mm
- Roll-off dumpster (20 yd), 122 x 49 x 31 mm
- Planetary concrete mixer on stand, 43 x 43 x 67 mm
- Planetary concrete mixer (500 L), 34 x 35 x 40 mm
- Mixer stand, 43 x 43 x 31 mm
- Pallet of concrete bags, 25 x 20 x 16 mm
- Industrial steel stair (12 ft), 94 x 21 x 94 mm
- Rail crossover gantry, 177 x 158 x 168 mm
- Temporary fence panel (6 x 10 ft), 65 x 12 x 37 mm
- Traffic cone (28 in), 7 x 7 x 14 mm
- Carry deck crane, 165 x 131 x 173 mm
- Bulk bag of concrete mix (1 t) on pallet, 24 x 22 x 26 mm

Filaments used across the set: Black, Blue, Construction yellow, Dark green, Light grey, Safety orange, Sand, Signal red, Silver grey, White, Wood brown.

Print with 0.12-0.16 mm layers and tree supports. A print guide with each model's size and filament slots is in the zip.
